blind.description: A clutch of five stylized alien or monster eggs situated on an organic, lumpy slime bed. Four of the eggs are intact and closed, featuring deep green shells partitioned by yellowish-tan seam ridges. The fifth egg is hatched, broken open at the top with jagged edges revealing a hollow reddish-brown interior. The organic base forms a flattened, bubbling mat that rests evenly on the ground.
blind.from_above: Resembles a five-pointed circular cluster or flower-like arrangement, with four rounded green pods bearing four-way yellow ridges and one open circular brown cavity in the fifth pod, surrounded by an irregular bumpy green-brown rim.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 1.3 to 1.5 ft tall), and roughly 1.8 to 2 ft in diameter.
